summary: Create a fresh signal and schedule timeout abortion using host active time.

target.notes: Reuse the existing DOM EventTarget subsystem for listener registration/dispatch; this rule owns AbortSignal-specific state and abort algorithms.

semantics.delay: HTML active-time timeout then timer task-source task

caveats: Ordinary wall-clock Task.Delay is not generally equivalent to HTML active time.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § AbortController / AbortSignal
